batches.topic: Adopted vs emerging Local Plan status
batches.title: Enfield adopted/emerging Local Plan status gate
batches.coverage: Enfield's adopted plan documents remain operative while the emerging Local Plan is under examination/modification. Emerging material must not be treated as adopted policy.

batches.title: Enfield policies-map spatial context gate
batches.coverage: The proposals/policies map is authoritative borough policy context but requires an exact map/location match before any candidate constraint is promoted.

batches.title: Enfield conservation-area local evidence gate
batches.coverage: Enfield publishes GIS downloads for 22 conservation areas. Exact parcel intersection is still required; borough-level presence is not parcel evidence.

batches.title: Enfield Article 4 exact-area/effectivity gate
batches.coverage: Enfield publishes Article 4 GIS datasets under OGL. Candidate impact requires exact area intersection plus the relevant direction/right/effective status.

batches.title: Enfield Brownfield Register exact-site gate
batches.coverage: Enfield's register is reviewed at least annually; Part 2 currently has no sites. Register membership must be matched to an exact site, not inferred from borough membership.

batches.title: Enfield CIL and planning-obligation applicability gate
batches.coverage: Enfield CIL and Mayoral CIL depend on use, location, floorspace, permission date and exemptions. Borough rates cannot be converted into parcel liability without scheme facts.

batches.title: Enfield planning-register exact-record gate
batches.coverage: Enfield's statutory register contains applications and decision notices. Candidate use requires an exact property/application link; nearby applications cannot be transferred.

batches.title: Havering adopted Local Plan status gate
batches.coverage: The Havering Local Plan 2016-2031 was adopted in 2021. Update work does not replace adopted policy until the statutory process completes.

batches.title: Havering emerging-plan timetable/status gate
batches.coverage: Havering's current Local Development Scheme was approved in April 2025 for 2025-2027. Emerging-plan steps must not be treated as adopted policy.

batches.title: Havering Aurora map spatial-context gate
batches.coverage: Aurora exposes planning application boundaries, conservation areas, TPOs and other map layers. Exact clicked/location geometry is required before candidate promotion.

batches.title: Havering conservation and Article 4 gate
batches.coverage: Havering has 11 conservation areas and some have Article 4 controls. Candidate effect requires exact conservation/Article 4 area matching, not borough-level inference.

batches.title: Havering Brownfield Register exact-site gate
batches.coverage: Havering warns its BLR site boundaries are not definitive and advises checking original sources. Exact site/application evidence is required before promotion.

batches.title: Havering 2026 CIL applicability gate
batches.coverage: Havering's CIL schedule took effect in 2019 and the page publishes 2026 indexed rates. Liability still requires development type, location, floorspace, date and exemptions.

batches.title: Havering planning-record exact-link gate
batches.coverage: Havering exposes planning application/decision/appeal searches and a map. Candidate use requires exact record/address/location matching; nearby records are not transferable.

batches.title: Lambeth adopted Local Plan status gate
batches.coverage: Lambeth Local Plan 2021 was adopted on 22 September 2021 and remains part of the statutory development plan while the new plan is prepared.

batches.title: Lambeth 2026 new-plan timetable/status gate
batches.coverage: Lambeth gave notice on 30 June 2026; preparation is expected to begin 31 October 2026 and adoption is currently scheduled for 30 April 2029. These are timetable milestones, not adopted policy.

batches.title: Lambeth policies-map and property-constraint gate
batches.coverage: Lambeth's policies map and property constraints tools provide location-specific policy context. Candidate effect requires exact property/coordinate binding.

batches.title: Lambeth conservation-area exact-property gate
batches.coverage: Lambeth reports 62 conservation areas covering about 30% of the borough. Exact property/area matching remains required before any candidate constraint is promoted.

batches.title: Lambeth Article 4 exact-area/effectivity gate
batches.coverage: Lambeth publishes Article 4 direction and area datasets under OGL. Candidate effect requires exact area intersection and the relevant direction/effective rights.

batches.title: Lambeth Brownfield Register exact-site gate
batches.coverage: Lambeth's BLR is updated at least annually and has no Part 2. The council exposes polygon mapping; exact polygon/site binding is required.

batches.title: Lambeth CIL and S106 applicability gate
batches.coverage: Lambeth CIL 2022 is in force and 2026 rate summaries are published; S106/CIL applicability requires exact scheme facts, floorspace/use/date and linked obligations.

batches.title: London strategic-plan current/draft status gate
batches.coverage: London Plan 2021 remains the current statutory planning framework. The Draft London Plan published 16 July 2026 is under consultation and must not be treated as adopted policy.
